title: User Search Request
description: Search for RMS users. All criteria are optional. 'username' is a LIKE search; 'id' and 'lastLoginFrom' are exact matches; date fields support range queries via *From/*To suffixes. Date values may be Unix timestamps (int) or date strings parseable by strtotime().

username.description: Partial username (e-mail) to search for. Uses SQL LIKE matching (wildcards added automatically).

lastLoginFrom.description: Exact IP address of the last login to match.

createdFrom.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for the 'created' timestamp. Unix timestamp or date string.

createdTo.description: Upper bound (inclusive) for the 'created' timestamp. Unix timestamp or date string.

modifiedFrom.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for the 'modified' timestamp. Unix timestamp or date string.

modifiedTo.description: Upper bound (inclusive) for the 'modified' timestamp. Unix timestamp or date string.

lastLoginAfter.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for the 'lastLogin' timestamp. Unix timestamp or date string.

lastLoginBefore.description: Upper bound (inclusive) for the 'lastLogin' timestamp. Unix timestamp or date string.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 100, max 1000.
